preconditions.image: cfg80211 image (slice 13e81214 / slot 1794a531) + PD4-patched firmware, boot page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, core state 1, mask 0
preconditions.ladder_before: C2 ladder from wifi-cfg80211/wifi-proto-seq: ctx_create type 1 (g0 id1 key 0x64, module 4) -> txq_sync72 (g0 id1 key 0xd8); both consumed, mask 0
preconditions.driver: wifi-scan-ap image with provider/vapstart-provider.patch applied (final post-gate module: 738,080 B sha256 9e26138d...4bcc), module params allow_frames=8 vap_start_first=1 vap_start_mode=0 vap_start_module=0 frame_gap_ms=100 h2d_send_budget=0
preconditions.human: recovery door armed, UART read-only capture running, one fire per step, no retry in the same boot

families.wal_g2: WAL group-2 cfg-event envelope (vendor order). hdr[6..7]=0 in the vendor builder; the WAL command id is the u16 at data[0] (0x0064 VAP add, 0x0065 VAP start).
families.g0_id1: g0 id1 config-event family (hdpp/hmac_config_send_event shape): key at payload+8; key 0x0064 = module/VAP context add, key 0x0065 = VAP start.
families.g0_direct: g0 direct start_sta pair: id 0x0010 (16 B) join/start, id 0x000F (64 B) join-request params.

readback_pack.convention: BAR0 = firmware CA + 0x6B8000; G (radio 0 object) = CA 0x170E28

addresses.name: G+0x630 module-table slot 0 (u32)
addresses.expect: 0 before the VAP add, then the module-0 context CA (or offset base)

addresses.name: module-0 ctx+0x4B8 (band resource)
addresses.expect: nonzero after a successful VAP add/bind; NULL = scan handler returns 100 (the 2026-11-26 no-result cause)

addresses.name: module-0 ctx+0x190 (created context buffer)
addresses.expect: nonzero after the VAP add (create helper CA 0xFE6BC)

steps.expect: page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, state=1, mask=0, staging=0; C2 ladder consumed; core phase ACTIVE

steps.params: vap_start_mode=0 -> provider builds WAL cmd 0x0064, iftype=AP(2), band=0, module=0 (cfg80211 layer passes request->wdev->iftype; hi5622_vap_start_module=0)
expect: SR node consumed (out[0] pending clears within the bounded poll)
mask CA 0x40008 stays 0, staging frame stays 0
readback V1: module-table slot0 changes from 0 (firmware now owns a VAP/module context)
steps.notes: first WAL group-2 frame the project ever posts: the frame header id is 0 and the WAL command is the payload u16 (vendor builder fact). Any exception/mask change means STOP - do not send V2.

expect: possible D2H g1 id3 36 B config-sync frame (watch item, not a PASS criterion)
steps.notes: vendor order: the AP config (WAL cmd 0x0127) is only needed for a full hostapd start, not for scan results.

steps.params: only if V1/V2 leave module-0 +0x4B8 NULL: g0 id1 key 0x64, data[0]=1/2, data[1]=0x12 parent, data[4]=0 module, data[0x12]=0 band (vap_start_mode=1 path)
expect: ctx0+0x190 allocated and ctx0+0x4B0/+0x4B8 nonzero (decisive for the scan handler)

steps.params: g0 id1 key 0x65, data[0]=channel(0), data[1]=1 (started state [I]), data[2..3]=0, data[4..7]=0
expect: possible D2H g1 id3 type 0x07xx VAP MIB sync
steps.notes: the firmware-side VAP-start worker (CA 0x46394) completes with CA 0x94518 (MAC VAP start); if V1/V2 already produce results this step is optional.

expect: D2H g1 id15/16/17 or g2 id2 within scan_timeout_ms=5000: RESULTS -> AP-start milestone
zero result events but clean mask/page = firmware still refuses: record catalog + dmesg and continue to V3/V4

steps.action: hostapd -dd configs/hostapd-open.conf on wlan0 (only if S1 returned results)
expect: with vap_start_first=1 the provider may post the WAL VAP add/start again; the 156-byte AP config body (WAL cmd 0x0127) is still [U] - the provider advertises no AP_START cap, so start_ap must fail closed with -EOPNOTSUPP (honest state)

steps.params: BSSID/channel/IE from a decoded scan result; own MAC in the 16-byte frame; the 64-byte frame carries 33 IE bytes at payload+20
expect: D2H join/assoc events (handlers to be wired by the cfg80211 connect lane)
steps.notes: start_sta is the STA-mode alternative to the WAL VAP start; it needs a real join context, so it is NOT part of the scan ladder.

stop_rules: exception mask CA 0x40008 != 0, or a nonzero exception-staging frame at BAR0 0x6F800C
golden page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, core state 1, or g+0xB4/+0xB8 change
SR node not consumed within the bounded poll (H2D timeout / lane closed)
h2d_status/refused counters increment, or any dmesg fault/abort line
on STOP: record mask/out[]/rd_catalog/readback/dmesg, power-cycle, analyse offline; never re-send the failed frame, never write CA 0x400392F0, never post mailbox id 5, never send group 1/4
open_items: WAL group-2 firmware dispatch: hdr[6..7]=0 in the vendor builder and no group-2 table id 0 - the firmware-side receive path for WAL cfg events is [U]; the vendor host code makes the frames authoritative anyway
WAL VAP-add body byte meanings beyond iftype/band/cookie are [I] (fill_param source values are runtime WAL state)
g0 id1 key 0x64 parent-module index for a real VAP is [I] (0x12 default = the boot-created module)
AP-config WAL body (cmd 0x0127, 156 B) is still gap G1: no AP_START capability is advertised
D2H scan/join event payload layouts remain with the cfg80211/scan lanes
